title: Hands-on AI workflow training for marketing reporting

facts: Source: jd.txt and intake-private.json in this job folder, captured 2026-10-19. The client requests one-on-one practical training, a trial lesson, weekly sessions, Make or n8n, spreadsheets, CRMs, marketing tools, agents, APIs and a first-four-lesson structure.

The post asks for teaching experience and an hourly rate. No teaching history is evidenced in the supplied material. Do not invent it. Rates and billing are excluded under UPWORK_PROCESS.md; Lorenzo must supply teaching background separately.
Yaffa is stated in two separate freelancer reviews: Outreach Strategies and PR, ended 2024-02-05; Content strategy, ended 2024-01-03. This supports a client-contact first name, not company ownership.
All report inputs, names, dates, counts, lesson artifacts and results here are invented sample data. This is visible sample proof, not past delivery or a connected live workflow.

n8n is one of the two platforms the client accepts. Manual Trigger, HTTP Request, Edit Fields and Google Sheets Append Row are supported by the frozen catalog. AI calls use HTTP Request, not unavailable AI Agent or Chat Model nodes. Workbench is a custom project workspace, not a native vendor UI.

items.body: Summarize the supplied campaign and CRM totals for this period. Show clicks / sent and qualified / leads with the arithmetic. Cite each input field. Flag missing values and do not guess causes. Suggest one question for the reviewer. Write plainly. Delete any line that only repeats or sells the last point, such as 'No more manual reporting.'

401: check the selected credential and required header. Empty total: inspect the prior response and field path. Missing qualified value: retain the report ID and flag it for review. Rerun with a new period, then compare source values before saving.

content.notice: Credential names, CRM endpoints and model choice are agreed in the lesson.
